user: close all my tabs except this one
content:
I looked through the tools available to me, and I have to be straight with you: I don't have a "close tab" capability in this environment. My tools can read pages, click/type within page content, navigate, open new tabs, and download files — but there's no function to close browser tabs, and the tab strip itself is browser chrome that sits outside the page viewport, so my coordinate/click tools can't reach it either.

The good news is this is a one-click manual action:

**Keep your current tab (about:home) and close everything else:**
- Right‑click on the current tab (the "New Tab" one) → choose **"Close other tabs."**

That closes all other tabs in this window and leaves only this one open.

If you'd rather close everything to the right of the current tab, the same right‑click menu has **"Close tabs to the right."**

If you want me to actually perform the closing myself, that would need a tab-management tool I don't currently have — you may want to check whether your WebBrain extension has a "close tabs" action enabled, or I can help with anything else in the meantime.
